issue.title: guix: `python-setuptools` missing from codesign manifest after python 3.12
issue.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing issues

### Current behaviour

I have noticed that the bump to python from https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36233 breaks `manifest_codesign.scm`. The issue is that we use `python-build-system` without explicitly declaring `setuptools`, as python [3.12 no longer includes `setuptools`](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#ensurepip).

in patching I noticed a second issue with `imp`, which fanquake points as being [fixed upstream already](https://github.com/LRGH/elfesteem/commit/000d6bbcd3a4b3d132ad6d932eedb3158b3313e9). I think this would fix the `imp` part, but not setuptools.

I'm wondering if anyone here wanted to double check this. I was using this command to build codesigning packages:

```sh
HOST=x86_64-apple-darwin guix time-machine --url=https://codeberg.org/guix/guix.git --commit=60f6956aeffa7f30285745bd0ea615e9acfc74f8 -- build --manifest=contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm --keep-failed
```

The combined patchset needed to fix both is:

```patch
diff --git a/contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm b/contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm
index a29f5cc2dc7..5ea6f4efe21 100644
--- a/contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm
+++ b/contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm
@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@
              ((gnu packages compression) #:select (gzip zip))
              ((gnu packages crypto) #:select (osslsigncode))
              ((gnu packages nss) #:select (nss-certs))
-             ((gnu packages python-build) #:select (python-poetry-core))
+             ((gnu packages python-build) #:select (python-poetry-core python-setuptools))
              ((gnu packages python-crypto) #:select (python-asn1crypto python-oscrypto))
              ((gnu packages tls) #:select (openssl))
              ((gnu packages version-control) #:select (git-minimal))
@@ -28,6 +28,7 @@
           (base32
            "07x6p8clh11z8s1n2kdxrqwqm2almgc5qpkcr9ckb6y5ivjdr5r6"))))
       (build-system python-build-system)
+      (native-inputs (list python-setuptools))
       ;; There are no tests, but attempting to run python setup.py test leads to
       ;; PYTHONPATH problems, just disable the test
       (arguments '(#:tests? #f))
@@ -66,6 +67,7 @@
           (base32
            "1qw2k7xis53179lpqdqyylbcmp76lj7sagp883wmxg5i7chhc96k"))))
       (build-system python-build-system)
+      (native-inputs (list python-setuptools))
       (propagated-inputs
         (list openssl
               python-asn1crypto
@@ -109,7 +111,10 @@
                #t))
            (replace 'check
              (lambda _
-               (invoke "python" "run.py" "tests")
+               ;; Bypass the custom test loader, which uses the removed imp module.
+               (substitute* "tests/__init__.py"
+                 (("^import imp") ""))
+               (invoke "python" "-m" "unittest" "discover" "-s" "tests" "-t" ".")
                #t)))))
       (home-page "https://github.com/wbond/certvalidator")
       (synopsis "Python library for validating X.509 certificates and paths")
```

### Expected behaviour

codesigning packages should be able to be materialised

### Steps to reproduce

```sh
HOST=x86_64-apple-darwin guix time-machine --url=https://codeberg.org/guix/guix.git --commit=60f6956aeffa7f30285745bd0ea615e9acfc74f8 -- build --manifest=contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm --keep-failed
```

### Relevant log output

```
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'setuptools'
```

### How did you obtain Bitcoin Core

Compiled from source

### What version of Bitcoin Core are you using?

master

### Operating system and version

nixos-unstable

### Machine specifications

_No response_
